hints.title: Find K-th Level Friends
hints.text: Run a level-by-level breadth-first search on the friendship network starting at id, stopping exactly at distance level.

hints.title: Count Watched Videos
hints.text: Collect all videos watched by people at distance level. Count the frequency of each video title in a frequency map.

hints.title: Sort by Frequency then Title
hints.text: Sort videos by frequency in ascending order. Break frequency ties using alphabetical order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: M: number of distinct videos watched at level k
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded path searches visit redundant branches without level-bounded shortest path pruning.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: BFS cleanly visits each person once and delivers exact k-th degree friends.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate manages the BFS level cutoff and multi-criteria sort (frequency, then lexicographical).
complexity.notes: People already visited at lower levels must not be included at higher levels.
